_help: Rules that mark plays as NOT personal listening. 'enabled' sets the site default (each rule can also be toggled in the site's Exclusions panel). Match on 'artists' (exact names), 'track_regex', 'album_regex', 'show_regex' (case-insensitive Python regex). Optional 'when' limits the rule to local weekdays (0=Mon..6=Sun) and a start/end time window. Re-run scripts/build_data.py after editing.

rules.label: Game-show theme music
rules.description: Jeopardy, The Price Is Right, Wheel of Fortune, Family Feud, Millionaire, etc.
rules.track_regex: jeopardy|price is right|wheel of fortune|family feud|who wants to be a millionaire|game show

rules.label: Lo-fi/focus music during school hours
rules.description: Artists played 84–94% of the time Mon–Fri 7:30am–3:00pm (Chilled Pig, Lowfie, Edward Ong, Minnz Piano, Lofi Fruits, Wildlife Bill, Todd Baker, Second Breakfast).

rules.label: Kids, party & movement songs
rules.description: Baby Shark, Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, Macarena, Hokey Pokey, VeggieTales, cartoon theme songs.
rules.track_regex: baby shark|cupid shuffle|cha cha slide|macarena|hokey|hairbrush song|magic school bus|my little pony|phineas and ferb|hot wheels

rules.label: Video-game themes
rules.description: Mario, Mario Kart and similar game music (mostly played during school hours).
rules.track_regex: super mario|mario kart|starman theme|coconut mall|rainbow road

rules.label: Sleep sounds & white noise
rules.description: White/brown noise and sleep-sound tracks and shows (≈126 hours).
